let fallbackSeq = 0;
function makeKey() {
  const c = globalThis.crypto;
  const uuid = c?.randomUUID?.();
  if (uuid) return uuid;
  const entropy = c?.getRandomValues?.(new Uint32Array(2));
  if (entropy) return `idem_${Date.now()}_${++fallbackSeq}_${entropy[0].toString(36)}${entropy[1].toString(36)}`;
  return `idem_${Date.now()}_${++fallbackSeq}`;
}
export function createIdempotencyTracker() {
  const keys = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  return {
    keyFor(actionId) {
      let k = keys.get(actionId);
      if (!k) {
        k = makeKey();
        keys.set(actionId, k);
      }
      return k;
    },
    clear(actionId) {
      keys.delete(actionId);
    }
  };
}
export function newIdempotencyKey() {
  return makeKey();
}
